=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- README.md:2593 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The README repeats “The reason is,” leaving the `all_gated` explanation grammatically malformed.
  WHY: This is documentation-only and makes the fallback-reason documentation harder for operators to read.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:246-296 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When an engine refusal and transfer rejection occur in the same run, the poller omits `engine_fallback_refused` from the recorded judge reason.
  WHY: The operator-facing reason can instead report a transfer error or default reason, obscuring the upstream engine refusal; both reviewers classify this as a low-severity issue.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:483-503, 510-524 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Claude crashes, timeouts, and output extraction failures can return their original status without going through `ai_engine_fallback`.
  WHY: These non-capacity failures produce no `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_REFUSED` log or fallback record, so the report step cannot report them as refused fallbacks.
- scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh:165-170 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The pre-source `support_missing` branch logs a refusal and exits 76 without calling `ai_engine_fallback` or appending to `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_RECORDS_FILE`.
  WHY: The report script reads only the records file, so it skips the refusal and produces no required heal report or Telegram warning.
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:228-233 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The pre-source `support_missing` branch logs a refusal and exits 76 without calling `ai_engine_fallback` or appending to `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_RECORDS_FILE`.
  WHY: The report script reads only the records file, so it skips the refusal and produces no required heal report or Telegram warning.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: “Audit every `claude_run` caller and every `rc == 75` / `-eq 75` branch. Confirm each one fails closed on 76.”
  expected_change_site: scripts/run_plan_codex.sh, scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh, scripts/self_heal_validation.sh, scripts/validate_process.sh, scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: run_plan_codex.sh switches to Codex when scripts/ai_engine.sh is missing; codex_thread_reuse.sh returns 75 for a missing helper and its caller treats 75 as permission to run Codex; self_heal_validation.sh and validate_process.sh invoke Codex directly when trusted engine support is unavailable; implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh is named among unaudited callers
- requirement: “Review sandbox Claude branches and the poller judges apply the same policy. A refused non-capacity fallback defers or fails through the existing failure paths.”
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh and scripts/review_consolidate.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: review_rb_judge.sh returns 75 when Claude sandbox preparation fails and its caller treats 75 as permission to run OpenCode; review_consolidate.sh proceeds to OpenCode without checking the policy and can fail-open with empty advisory output on exit 76
- requirement: “Ensure all unhandled claude_run outcomes emit AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_REFUSED and create refusal records for the reporting step.”
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh, `claude_run` outcome handling
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: The outer handler maps only private statuses 76, 75, and 78, then returns other statuses unchanged; failed extraction and other unhandled outcomes therefore do not emit refusal logs or records
- requirement: “Note in the PR description and README” that consumers without a Claude pool fail Claude-default roles under capacity, including the `AI_ENGINE=codex` or `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY=always` switches, and state that D1 is final.
  expected_change_site: PR description
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The README contains the consumer warning and switches, but the PR description only references issues and does not state the no-pool consequence, rollback options, or that D1 is final
- requirement: “If another caller needs an edit, report it in the PR description instead of editing it.”
  expected_change_site: PR description
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description does not name the out-of-scope callers that were audited or report their remaining fallback paths
- requirement: “list every reused commit SHA in the PR description.”
  expected_change_site: PR description
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description does not list reused commit SHAs from #6209 / #6615
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- README.md:2593 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The prose reads "The reason is the reason is `all_gated`" — the phrase "The reason is" is duplicated.
  WHY: Documentation-only; the runtime logic in security_audit.sh is correct. The malformed sentence makes the published README variables table harder to read but causes no operational failure.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Audit every claude_run caller and every rc == 75 / -eq 75 branch. ... Confirm each one fails closed on 76. Edit only the files in files_touched. If another caller needs an edit, report it in the PR description instead of editing it." (Issue #6705, "Implementer discipline" section)
  Expected change site: PR description body
  Evidence of absence: The PR description reads only "Automated implementation. Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/6705\nRefs #6664". It does not name any callers that were audited but not edited. The following callers switch directly to codex on missing support without checking AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY, and none are mentioned: run_plan_codex.sh lines 271-277 (sets PLAN_ENGINE="codex" unconditionally when scripts/ai_engine.sh is absent), codex_thread_reuse.sh lines 648-650 (returns 75 unconditionally when ai_engine.sh is absent, causing the caller at line 756-761 to run codex). The issue explicitly permitted reporting these in the PR description rather than editing them; neither caller nor a similar finding was reported.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: if [ "${rb_engine_refused}" = true ] && [ "${rb_transfer_rejected}" = false ] | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The engine_fallback_refused reason is discarded if a transfer rejection also occurs in the same run.
  WHY: The recorded judge reason is overwritten by the sandbox_transfer_failed flag, potentially misdirecting operators to a transfer error when the underlying failure was actually an AI engine refusal.
- README.md: The reason is the reason is `all_gated` | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Duplicated phrase "The reason is".
  WHY: Malformed documentation, confusing for operators scanning fallback behaviors.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Under AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY=capacity, non-capacity reasons such as support_missing must not run Codex; fallback records and reports must cover refusals."
  Expected change site: scripts/run_plan_codex.sh, scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh, scripts/self_heal_validation.sh, scripts/validate_process.sh, scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, and scripts/review_consolidate.sh.
  Evidence of absence: These scripts call claude_run or interpret its result but do not explicitly check for exit code 76 to fail closed; they continue to the Codex fallback path or proceed as if the Claude step succeeded, violating the fail-closed requirement for non-capacity refusals.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Note in the PR description and README that a consumer repository with no Claude pool provisioned will fail Claude-default roles under capacity, and state the rollback."
  Expected change site: PR description.
  Evidence of absence: The PR description does not state the no-pool consequence, the AI_ENGINE=codex or AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY=always options, or that D1 is final.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- README.md: line 2593 (security-audit Engine paragraph) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The rewritten prose contains a duplicated "The reason is" — the diff reads "The reason is the reason is `all_gated` (every account at or above the 90% usage gate …)".
  WHY: Operators scanning the engine-fallback reason tokens will trip on the broken grammar; the rationale paragraph is otherwise intact but the lead-in is ungrammatical.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 246-296 in `_poller_rb_judge_sandbox_attempt()` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the sandbox exits 76 (engine refused) AND the post-run cleanup/transfer path also fails, the final guard `[ "${rb_engine_refused}" = true ] && [ "${rb_transfer_rejected}" = false ]` is false, so `engine_fallback_refused` is NOT written to `judge_reason_file`.
  WHY: The poller still defers with exit 77 in both cases — functional behaviour is preserved — but the operator-facing reason text is wrong when both failures happen. The engine-fallback refusal was the upstream cause; the transfer failure is downstream. Recording the upstream reason preserves the diagnostic chain.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Review sandbox Claude branches (`scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh`) and the poller judges … apply the same policy. A refused non-capacity fallback defers or fails through the existing failure paths."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (lines around 151-153 and 1628-1637 where `claude_run` exit codes are interpreted) and scripts/review_consolidate.sh (lines around 635-644 where the Claude result feeds the OpenCode branch).
  Evidence of absence: review_untrusted_sandbox.sh now distinguishes 75 (capacity) from 76 (refused) per the PR, but its in-workflow callers were not edited and were not audited in the PR description. review_rb_judge.sh returns 75 on Claude-sandbox preparation failure and the surrounding caller interprets 75 as permission to run OpenCode; a 76 from a refused non-capacity fallback therefore routes to OpenCode unless the caller was updated to gate on `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_EXIT`. Same gap in review_consolidate.sh's Claude-result handling — exit 76 fail-opens to empty advisory output, never fails the step. The issue spec instructs: "If another caller needs an edit, report it in the PR description instead of editing it." — no such note is in the PR description.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
